annotations.title: House prices, debt service, credit and exchange rates by country

description: Where countries stand in their financial cycle, from the Bank for International Settlements: house prices (real and nominal, with the change on a year), the share of income households and companies spend servicing debt, credit to households, companies and government as a share of GDP, and real and nominal effective exchange rates. Up to eight countries side by side, 40 to 60 economies covered, with history. No key.

countries.description: ISO country codes, e.g. ["CA", "AU", "CN"]; XM is the euro area.

measures.description: house_prices, debt_service, credit and exchange_rate. Default all four.

periods.description: Quarters of history for each series (months three times as many for exchange rates). Default 8.

name: financial_cycle

outputSchema.description: latest gives each country's newest value of each measure with its period; each measure is also a table of country, period and series, oldest first.

title: House prices, debt service, credit and exchange rates by country
